specificationScope.market: Czech Republic / individually documented pre-facelift test version
specificationScope.noteCs: Samostatna verze Junior1.2HTP podle technicke tabulky doboveho testu Auto.cz. Clanek vyslovne upozornuje na provedeni pred faceliftem; datum vyroby ani modelovy rok neurceny. Hmotnost1010kg je v tabulce oznacena pohotovostni, zahrnuti ridice neni uvedeno. Kombinovana spotreba5.9l/100km je tabulkovy udaj, konkretni homologacni predpis neni urcen. Neprepisuje Junior1.0MPI37kW. Plna stranka pri primem otevreni vratila403; tabulka a poznamka o provedeni byly dostupne ve vyhledavacim indexu.

sourceDecisions.access: Direct full-page open returned HTTP 403. The search index returned the article's technical table, conclusion and explicit note that the tested car preceded the facelift; those indexed passages were read. No claim of full direct-page access.
sourceDecisions.sourceVersion: Fabia Junior 1.2 HTP, 1198 cm3, three cylinders, 40 kW; preceding facelift according to article note. It is not the existing 1.0 MPI 997 cm3, four-cylinder, 37 kW record.

fields.reason: The article explicitly associates the 1010 kg kerb figure with the tested 1198 cm3 three-cylinder 40 kW version. It cannot establish the 997 cm3 four-cylinder 37 kW version's mass or resolve its 1010/1035 kg discrepancy.

fields.sourceValue: pohotovostni hmotnost; driver inclusion not stated in indexed table
fields.reason: No driver inclusion or exact original manufacturing year is established by the retrieved passages. Do not add 75 kg or identify an assumed test-year model.
The test is a separate 1.2 HTP engine; 1198 is not a correction to the 1.0 MPI record.
The supplied test table's combined value belongs to 1.2 HTP. No NEDC/WLTP standard was inferred from the publication's age.

fields.decision: no change: matching body dimensions do not identify engine or mass

sourceDecisions.outcome: Deferred in initial worker brief; amended after clarification to add this independently documented 1.2 HTP Junior as a separate version. Existing 1.0 MPI remains unchanged.
